name: b3os-ai-code-safety
description: AI 가 만들거나 고친 코드의 구조·리팩토링 가이드. 프로그램 구조 설계, 새 코드 작성, 코드 리뷰, 코드 냄새(한 곳을 고치면 여러 곳이 바뀌거나 엉뚱한 곳이 깨짐) 리팩토링 때 쓴다. SOLID 경계, 부수효과를 줄이는 구조, 동시성·트랜잭션·멱등성 게이트, 외부 입력 처리, 테스트 규칙을 다룬다.

name: b3os-bwf
description: b3rys 팀 기본 과제 수행 워크플로우(b3os workflow). 과제를 받으면 PM계획→팀배정→실행+품질방법→검증→보고+카드→학습hook 순으로 끝까지 끌고 가는 단일 진입점(stage router). BWF는 harness가 아니다 — harness/multi-ai/judge panel/적대적리뷰는 BWF 안에서 고르는 '품질방법'이다. 과제·프로젝트·구현·리서치·리뷰·릴리즈 등 실행이 필요한 일이면 이 흐름을 기본으로 쓴다. 얇은 오케스트레이터 — 실제 도구는 하위 스킬(task-loop·harness·report·team-inbox·learning-loop) 참조. 전 런타임(claude/openclaw/hermes). owner=maintainer.

name: b3os-github-workflow
description: 팀원이 코드 변경을 GitHub PR로 올려 승인·머지까지 가는 절차 — 브랜치·worktree 격리, 커밋 신원, PR 작성 계정, 검증 근거, 승인 기록(Approved-by), 머지 후 확인. 저장소에 남는 글(코드·주석·커밋·PR·이슈·문서)을 사실과 인과로 쓰는 규칙도 여기 있다. 승인·안전 정책은 TEAM-OS가 정본이고 여기는 절차만 다룬다.

name: b3os-harness-playbook
description: b3rys 팀 harness(sub agent 병렬 실행) 플레이북 — 트리거 우선. "중요 프로젝트 구현은 역할 분리(구현+독립 리뷰)가 기본. 병렬 실소스 커버 모양이면 limited harness를 더하고, 그 외에는 병렬로 나누지 않는다." 트리거 리스트 + ready-run 레시피(audit·migration·N후보) + 구조 규약(역할분리 에이전트·프론트매터·오케스트레이터 분리·파일 산출, 실물 템플릿) + 8 품질패턴 + 런타임별(클로드 네이티브 Workflow / openclaw 수동 캡) + 비용 게이트. 사용 시점 — 코드 audit·다PR 리뷰·마이그레이션·멀티소스 리서치·N후보 비교·다면 교차검증·릴리즈 전 검증 등 '여러 군데 동시'가 보일 때 자동으로 이 스킬의 레시피를 집는다. Workflow/subagent fan-out 전. ※ 실행 엔진이 아니라 결정+품질 플레이북(실행은 네이티브 Workflow/Agent 툴). 에이전트+스킬 구성 메타스킬 `harness`와 다름. owner=maintainer.

name: b3os-how-to-explain
description: 한국어로 설명·보고할 때 독자가 되묻지 않게 쓰는 규칙. 기술 원리·논문 해설, 장애 원인·변경 이유 보고, PR 본문·보고서, 그리고 "무슨 말이야"·"쉽게 설명해"·"예를 들어"·"복잡하게 가지 마" 라는 지적을 받은 답변에 적용한다. SNS·블로그 집필(gd-writer)과는 다르다. owner=maintainer.

name: b3os-infra-safety
description: b3os 플랫폼 자체(설정·소스·registry·배포)를 수정할 때 지킬 안전 규칙. 팀원이 b3os 코드/config/agents.json/team.db/릴리스를 건드리는 작업을 할 때 필독. 브랜치·worktree 격리, 런타임 상태(agents.json·team.db) 보호, 백업, 테스트 FS 격리, 릴리스/배포 가드, 격리 검증. 일반 팀작업이 아니라 b3os 인프라를 고칠 때만 해당. owner=maintainer.

name: b3os-model-rollout
description: 팀원 런타임(hermes · codex · openclaw)의 모델을 새 모델로 바꿀 때 쓰는 절차와 도구. 팀원별 지금 모델 확인(inventory), 새 모델이 그 런타임·계정에서 실제로 응답하는지 확인(check — 설정 안 바꿈), 미리보기 뒤 한 팀원씩 백업 → 설정 한 줄 → 그 팀원만 재시작 → 실제 응답 모델 확인 → 실패 시 자동 복원(apply). 새 프론티어 모델이 나왔을 때, 주간 모델 점검 때, "팀원 모델 바꿔줘" 요청 때 사용. 다른 맥은 --host 로 같은 절차.

name: b3os-scheduler
description: b3os durable 스케줄러로 반복(cron)·간격(interval)·1회성(reminder) 잡을 등록하는 팀 스킬. 시·분·요일·월 cron + 잡별 휴일정책(run/skip/shift, KST)을 잡 등록 시 받아 team.db에 durable 저장하고, 서버 내 워커가 시각 맞춰 발화(인박스 wake). 세션 cron(런타임별 CronCreate)은 세션 죽으면 유실되므로, 팀 정본 반복작업은 이 스케줄러를 쓴다.

name: b3os-sf

name: baa-ch01-introduction-to-agents
description: Scoping guidance for agentic systems, based on Chapter 1 of Michael Albada's "Building Applications with AI Agents". Covers the real-agent test, choosing code vs workflow vs RAG vs agent, async "work arrives prepared" design, agent types and reference use cases, model selection and routing, LangGraph/AutoGen/CrewAI/OpenAI Agents SDK trade-offs, five build principles, and organizing teams. Use when someone asks whether a problem needs an agent, which model or framework to start with, how to make an agent scalable and maintainable, or how to govern agent experiments.

name: baa-ch02-designing-agent-systems
description: Guides end-to-end design of an agent system, based on Chapter 2 of Michael Albada's "Building Applications with AI Agents" (O'Reilly, 2025). Covers scoping a first bounded workflow, model selection (size, modality, open vs proprietary, routing, VRAM), tools, memory, orchestration, speed/scale/reliability/cost trade-offs, single vs multiagent choice, evaluation and phased rollout. Use when starting an agent project, choosing or pricing models, deciding whether to go multiagent, or planning agent testing and production launch.

name: baa-ch03-ux-design-for-agentic-systems
description: UX design guidance for AI agents: choosing and combining modalities (text, GUI, generative UI, voice, video), autonomy sliders, sync vs async flows, proactive notifications, context and personalization, capability discovery, confidence signaling, clarifying questions, graceful failure and trust. Based on Chapter 3 of Michael Albada's "Building Applications with AI Agents". Use when designing or reviewing an agent's user-facing interaction, picking a modality, setting human-approval levels, writing error or clarification flows, or diagnosing low adoption or trust.

name: baa-ch04-tool-use
description: Guidance for designing, choosing, securing and operating the tools an AI agent calls, based on Chapter 4 ("Tool Use") of Michael Albada's "Building Applications with AI Agents" (O'Reilly, 2025). Covers local, API, plug-in and MCP tools, tool metadata, stateful-tool safety, agent-generated tools and tool-choice/fallback control. Use when defining or reviewing tool schemas, deciding where a tool should live, exposing a database or API to an agent, adopting MCP, letting an agent write code, or hardening tool-call failures.

name: baa-ch05-orchestration
description: Guidance for orchestrating AI agents, based on Chapter 5 of Michael Albada's "Building Applications with AI Agents". Covers agent archetypes (reflex, ReAct, planner-executor, query decomposition, reflection, deep research), standard/semantic/hierarchical tool selection, tool parametrization and execution, tool topologies (single, parallel, chain, graph) and context engineering. Use when choosing an agent type, picking tools from a large catalog, designing a chain or LangGraph-style graph, assembling per-step context, or evaluating planning approaches.

name: baa-ch06-knowledge-and-memory
description: Guides the design of agent knowledge and memory, based on Chapter 6 of Michael Albada's "Building Applications with AI Agents" (O'Reilly, 2025). Covers context-window budgeting, rolling FIFO windows, BM25 keyword memory, vector-store semantic memory, RAG, semantic experience memory, GraphRAG and knowledge-graph construction, long context vs retrieval, dynamic graphs, and self-notes. Use when choosing or debugging an agent's memory or retrieval layer, deciding whether GraphRAG is worth it, planning a context budget, or hardening a knowledge graph.

name: baa-ch07-learning-in-agentic-systems
description: Guidance for making agents improve from experience, based on Chapter 7 of Michael Albada's "Building Applications with AI Agents". Covers nonparametric learning (dynamic few-shot exemplars, Reflexion, ExpeL-style insight lists) and parametric learning (when to fine-tune, SFT for function calling, DPO, RLVR, small vs large models). Use when deciding whether an agent should learn at all, designing a feedback or memory loop, choosing between prompting and fine-tuning, preparing tool-call or preference datasets, or picking a model size to tune.

name: baa-ch08-from-one-agent-to-many
description: Guidance for deciding when to move from one agent to many, how to split responsibilities, which coordination pattern to use (democratic, manager, hierarchical, swarm, actor-critic, automated design/ADAS), and which communication, execution and state infrastructure fits (A2A, Kafka/Redis/NATS, Ray/Orleans/Akka, Temporal/Airflow). Based on Chapter 8 of Michael Albada's "Building Applications with AI Agents". Use when an agent has too many tools, when designing a supervisor or multiagent topology, when adding an agent, or when choosing brokers, actors, workflow engines or persistence for agents.

name: baa-ch09-validation-and-measurement
description: Evaluation and validation playbook for LLM agents, based on Chapter 9 of Michael Albada's "Building Applications with AI Agents". Covers hero scenarios and metric choice, structured eval cases and how to grow them, unit tests for tools, planning, memory and learning, end-to-end scoring (tool recall/precision, parameter accuracy, phrase recall, task success), consistency, coherence, hallucination, hostile inputs, and release gates. Use when designing an agent eval suite, scoring agent traces, debugging regressions, or deciding if an agent is ready to ship.

name: baa-ch10-monitoring-in-production
description: Production monitoring for LLM agents, based on Chapter 10 of Michael Albada's "Building Applications with AI Agents" (O'Reilly, 2025). Covers failure-versus-noise triage, a layered metric taxonomy, stack choice (Grafana/Loki/Tempo, ELK, Phoenix, SigNoz, Langfuse), OpenTelemetry span design, dashboards and alerts, shadow and canary releases, regression traces, self-healing fallbacks, user feedback, drift tests (KS, KL, PSI) and RACI ownership. Use when instrumenting, observing, alerting on, rolling out or debugging deployed agents.

name: baa-ch11-improvement-loops
description: Designs feedback-driven improvement loops for production agent systems, based on Chapter 11 of Michael Albada's "Building Applications with AI Agents". Covers failure detection and root cause analysis, HITL escalation thresholds, prompt and tool refinement (DSPy, Trace, APO), backlog prioritization, shadow deployments, A/B tests, Bayesian Bandits, in-context adaptation and offline retraining. Use when an agent keeps failing in production, when planning how to validate or roll out a prompt/tool change, when sizing or reading an experiment, or when deciding how fixes should persist.

name: baa-ch12-protecting-agentic-systems
description: Security and resilience guidance for LLM agent systems, based on Chapter 12 of Michael Albada's "Building Applications with AI Agents" (O'Reilly, 2025). Covers agent-specific risks, HITL weaknesses, prompt-injection threat taxonomy, model selection and layered defenses, red teaming, MAESTRO threat modeling, data privacy/provenance, agent safeguards, external threats and internal failures. Use when designing, reviewing, threat-modeling, red-teaming, hardening or monitoring an agent, its tools, data flows or multiagent setup.

name: baa-ch13-human-agent-collaboration
description: Human-agent collaboration guidance based on Chapter 13 of Michael Albada's "Building Applications with AI Agents". Covers human roles (executor to governor), progressive delegation, adoption rollouts, agent scopes and RBAC, scoped memory, trust repair, accountability (audits, logs, traceability), escalation thresholds, and compliance in CI. Use when deciding how much autonomy an agent gets, designing approval or handoff flows, planning a pilot, scoping memory or permissions for team or enterprise agents, or preparing governance and regulatory controls.

Activate whenever the player wants a new agent, wants to change, pause, restart, retire or revive an existing one, asks what an agent is allowed to risk, or wants to intervene in a position an agent has open.

name: battlegrid-arena-play

Activate whenever the player asks what the market is doing, whether to be long or short, which coins are moving, or for a read on a specific coin.

name: battlegrid-officers
description: Set up and govern the player's Strategy Officers and work their reviews — create or change an officer through its draft, run one now, read when each runs and what is waiting, and apply, push or dismiss the proposals its reviews carry. It never writes a review. Activate whenever the player wants a new Strategy Officer, wants to change, pause or archive one, wants one to run now, asks what their officers found or when they run, or wants to apply, push or dismiss an officer's proposal.

name: battlegrid-onboarding
description: Walk the player through setting up their account — from nothing to an agent armed on Radar — one step at a time, in the order the server serves. Reads the player's readiness, does each step the Commander can do through the skill that owns it, hands each step only the player can do to the app, and stops when the account is battle-ready. Activate whenever the player asks to get set up, to start, what to do next, to walk them through setup, or why their agents cannot trade yet.

name: battlegrid-radar-deployment
description: Deploy the player's agents to standing duty — Radar deployments, each one team's watch on one coin, that put every matching rule's agent on duty and fire real trades at confirmed closes, one agent onto several coins at once, and per-preset Arena deployment policies that enter sessions automatically. Reads what is deployed now, stages a change into the player's draft, previews what it would actually resolve to, commits it only after the player has seen that preview, and un-deploys with the blast radius stated. Activate whenever the player wants an agent put on duty, wants to change or pause a…

Also forks, tunes, restores, archives and previews existing strategies. Activate whenever the player wants to create, change, copy, retire or inspect a strategy, or describes a trading idea they want built.

name: battlegrid-strategy-doctor

Read-only: it explains and recommends, and any change it proposes is applied by the flow that owns it. Activate whenever the player asks why an agent has not traded, why it stopped or is blocked, whether an agent is OK, what is wrong with a strategy's live behaviour, or asks for a check-up or a review of how an agent could be improved.

name: biotransformation-candidate-integration-with-networking
description: Use when you have output from a biotransformation rules module (candidate transformed structures linked to anchor molecules) and untargeted MS/MS spectral data, and you want to identify molecular families and annotate features with predicted structures by leveraging spectral similarity and network.

name: biotransformation-enumeration
description: Use when you have a known parent drug chemical formula and aim to predict its metabolite landscape prior to or during high-resolution mass spectrometry analysis (mzML).

name: biotransformation-prediction-across-microbiota-contexts
description: Use when you have one or more small-molecule chemical structures (as SMILES, MOL, or SDF) and need to systematically explore their fate across mammalian biotransformation, human gut microbial degradation, or environmental (soil/aquatic) microbial degradation.

name: biotransformation-reaction-rule-matching
description: Use when untargeted LC-HRMS feature tables lack library MS2 matches but samples are enzymatic incubations (e.g., human liver S9) of known parent xenobiotics, so candidates can be derived in silico from reaction rules rather than reference spectra.

name: biotransformation-rule-application
description: Use when an MS/MS query spectrum is unannotated but a spectral-similarity neighbor (anchor) with a known SMILES and a precursor mass difference is available, and candidate molecular structures for the suspect are needed.

name: biotransformation-rule-application
description: Use when when you have a small-molecule structure (SMILES, MOL, or SDF format) and need to predict its fate in soil or aquatic environments through microbial degradation pathways.

name: biotransformation-rule-application-to-metabolites
description: Use when you have untargeted metabolomics data with unknown or ambiguous molecular identities, anchor metabolites (known structures in SMILES or MOL format), and a curated database of biotransformation rules (e.g., from KEGG, RetroRules, or domain-specific repositories).

name: biotransformation-rule-encoding
description: Use when you have untargeted metabolomics data with unknown metabolite structures and need to generate plausible candidate products by systematically applying known enzymatic or chemical transformation rules.

name: biotransformation-rule-extraction-from-database
description: Use when you need to populate or reconstruct a biotransformation prediction module and have access to a curated biotransformation database (such as EAWAG BBD) that documents empirically validated microbial degradation pathways, enzyme-substrate relationships, and reaction outcomes.

name: biotransformation-rule-mass-difference-matching
description: Use when a query spectrum has high spectral similarity to a known anchor molecule in a molecular network, and the precursor mass difference between suspect and anchor must be converted into a list of plausible biotransformation-derived candidate structures.

name: biotransformation-rule-normalization

name: blazium-behavior
description: Implements a GDScript behavior tree (blackboard, sequence, selector, leaf tick) and utility scoring curves. Use when an NPC needs structured ticks or graded action scores. Native goal planning stays on blazium-goap.

name: blazium-camera
description: Builds follow, deadzone, look-ahead, level bounds, orbit, first-person, and multi-target cameras on Camera2D, Camera3D, and SpringArm3D. Use for framing and smoothing. Pixel snap stays on blazium-pixel-perfect. Hit-stop and punch stay on blazium-game-feel.

name: blazium-ci-export
description: Wires GitHub Actions for Blazium (setup-blazium-engine, setup-blazium-cli, export-blazium-game, deploy-blazium-game). Use for CI export, Autowork jobs, and deploy keys from Games MCP. Not engine SCons CI and not local presets.

name: blazium-ci-watch
description: Watches Blazium export/CI, reads the first failing job, and hands off to blazium-ci-export or Autowork. Use when GitHub Actions or a local export job failed. One failure at a time. Use gh only when the repo is on GitHub.

name: blazium-cli
description: Installs and updates Blazium editors, templates, Hub, Crash Reporter, and the toolchain via top-level blazium-cli verbs. Use when the editor is missing or update apply --product is needed. Do not use for Hub UI (blazium-hub) or a running editor's HTTP /v1 (blazium-cli-remote).

name: blazium-cli-remote
description: Controls a running Blazium editor or game via blazium-cli remote (HTTP /v1 remote_control, default port 6508). Use for status, exec, eval, logs, debugger, snapshot, instance discovery, doctor, and Autowork from CI. Do not use for editor JustAMCP (blazium-mcp), res://mcp game tools (blazium-game-mcp), or cloud Games MCP (blazium-games-mcp).

name: blazium-clicker
description: Uses BlaziumBigNum for idle/incremental economies that overflow int/float. Use for construct, ops, and serialize of huge numbers (from_string, as_string, add/mul). Not a full idle framework, not genre-idle composition, and not for normal scores or HP.

name: blazium-coldstorage
description: Connects the Blazium editor to ColdStorageVCS (cstoraged on port 1666), not Git. Use when the studio uses ColdStorage. Secrets stay in EditorSettings. Do not replace git in this ecosystem repo.

name: blazium-config
description: Loads Blazium ENV (.env) and DotIniFile (.ini) — secrets, overrides, and property binds. Use instead of inventing OS.get_environment / ConfigFile wrappers. Not ProjectSettings.

name: blazium-crash-analytics
description: Configures in-engine Analytics and CrashReporter (app_id, build_id, consent, crash.blazium.app). Use when enabling telemetry or crash uploads. Sidecar binary → blazium-crash-reporter. Cloud list → blazium-games-mcp.

name: blazium-crash-reporter
description: Installs and wires the official Blazium crash_reporter sidecar (consent UI that uploads .dmp + .json). Use for --crash-reporter path, reporter_filename, and sidecar CLI flags. Not in-engine Analytics and not a custom Breakpad.

name: blazium-csharp
description: Writes Godot/Blazium C# gameplay (partial classes, Export/Signal, GDScript interop) on Blazium 0.8.x. Use when the project already uses .NET/C#. AutoworkTest discovery works when MODULE_MONO_ENABLED; no C# assert DSL.

name: blazium-csv
description: Parses and queries Blazium CSV/DSV tables (CSVTable, CSVReader/Writer, CSVImporter, CSVAsyncTask). Use instead of FileAccess + split(","). Not TranslationServer workflows or SQLite.

name: blazium-dialogue
description: Authors a data-driven dialogue graph on Blazium 0.8.x (.tres or JSON nodes with lines, choices, and flags). All strings go through tr(). Use for branching talk, not a full visual-novel scene flow. Do not require Ink or Yarn.

name: blazium-discord
description: Integrates Blazium Discord on 0.8.x / 4.8.x: native Social SDK (presence, OAuth, friends, authenticate_with_server) and DiscordEmbeddedAppClient for Embedded Apps. Use for Discord identity or activity. Not generic web export.

name: blazium-enet-server
description: Runs Blazium’s threaded ENetServer / ENetClient singletons. Use for dedicated servers and Variant packets. RCON admin → blazium-rcon. Not SceneMultiplayer RPC and not lobby matchmaking.

name: blazium-enet-webrtc
description: Sets up Blazium ENet-over-WebRTC (WebRTCEnetSession, SignalClient) for NAT traversal. Not in the default editor — custom SCons, verify ClassDB.class_exists("WebRTCEnetSession"). Use when lobby peers need DataChannels or WSS relay. Not dedicated ENetServer.

name: blazium-environment
description: Configures WorldEnvironment / Environment (glow, tonemap, SSAO, sky) on Prefer JustAMCP environment_create.

name: blazium-example-analytics-server
description: Recreates the self-hosted Go analytics ingest from example_analytics_server (JSONL store, POST /v1/events, port 8091). Use when standing up a local analytics sink for a Blazium game. Not Games MCP cloud analytics and not in-game HTTPServer.

name: blazium-example-crash-server
description: Recreates the self-hosted Go crash ingest from example_crash_reporter_server (multipart /v1/reports, Breakpad stackwalk, port 8090). Use when standing up a local crash sink. Not the official sidecar product and not Games MCP.

name: blazium-example-crash-sidecar
description: Recreates the example crash_reporter consent UI project (lists pending .dmp files, uploads after confirm). Use when forking a sidecar beside the game. Official product install stays on blazium-crash-reporter.

name: blazium-export
description: Exports Blazium desktop and mobile players (Win/Mac/Linux/Android) via presets, JustAMCP export_tools, and blazium-cli templates. Use when shipping a normal player or deploying to Android. Not web, retro, or wallpaper.

name: blazium-export-web
description: Exports Blazium to HTML5 with COOP/COEP, YouTube Playables (YoutubePlayablesClient), and Discord Embedded Apps host/Docker webbuild. Use for browser, Playables, or *.discordsays.com. Not native Discord SDK.

name: blazium-game-feel
description: Adds juice on Blazium 0.8.x with Tween, AnimationPlayer, particles, and camera punch (hit-stop, squash, screenshake). Use for feedback polish on an existing mover or Control. Movement controllers stay on blazium-2d-movement; clip libraries on blazium-animation.

name: blazium-game-mcp
description: Authors project-owned JustAMCP game tools in res://mcp/register.gd or register.luau via JustAMCPRuntime. Use when connecting user-blazium-game on :6507, adding play-mode/export MCP tools, or when the game list is empty. Do not use for the editor catalog (blazium-mcp), HTTP /v1 (blazium-cli-remote), or cloud Games MCP (blazium-games-mcp).

name: blazium-games-analytics
description: Read and summarize Blazium Games visitor analytics for a game page, including views, unique visitors, countries, and tracked actions. Use when the user asks how their game page is doing, for traffic numbers, or for a weekly analytics summary.

name: blazium-games-crash-reporting
description: Send crash reports, standard launch events, and custom events from a game to Blazium Games. Configures the Blazium Engine crash reporter or a custom HTTP reporter with X-App-Id and X-Build-Id, adds the session_start, boot_ok, first_input, session_end, and quit events that rate launch health, uploads Breakpad symbols with chauffeur, and verifies reports arrive. Use when the user wants crash reporting, crash dumps, symbols, launch health, error telemetry, or gameplay events for a Blazium Games project.

name: blazium-games-debug-crash
description: Investigate Blazium Games crash reports. Lists recent crashes, reads the stack excerpt and metadata, downloads dumps, logs, or stackwalk output, maps the crash to a build and source code, and proposes a fix. Use when the user asks to look at crashes, debug a crash, or triage crash reports for a Blazium Games project.

name: blazium-games-deploy
description: Ship game builds to Blazium Games from CI or the command line. Issues rotated deploy keys, registers a build and uploads its zipped files and Breakpad symbols with the chauffeur CLI (or the upload API), and wires the build_id into crash reporting. Use when the user wants to deploy, upload, publish a build, upload symbols or store images, or set up GitHub Actions or GitLab CI for Blazium Games.

name: blazium-games-get-started
description: Connect Cursor to Blazium Games and route to the right skill. Blazium Games is a game publishing platform, with an infrastructure focus. The developer server (mcp.blazium.games/developer) publishes pages, builds, crashes, analytics, and keys. The player server (mcp.blazium.games/player) finds, reviews, installs, and buys. Use when the user mentions Blazium Games for the first time, asks how to connect, or is unsure whether they want to play or publish.

name: blazium-games-keys
description: Inspect and rotate Blazium Games credentials, including MCP API keys and per-game deploy keys, with warnings before destructive rotation and the owner's approval, and create redeemable game keys and gift links. Use when the user wants to rotate, revoke, list, or replace a Blazium Games key, suspects a key leaked, or wants to hand out game keys.

name: blazium-games-lobby-pack
description: Publish a Luau lobby pack with chauffeur and check it on the Scripted lobby tab.

name: blazium-games-mcp
description: Uses the Blazium Games cloud MCP (https://mcp.blazium.games/mcp) for store pages, analytics, crashes, deploy keys, and builds. Use for live-ops dashboard work. Never confuse with editor JustAMCP or game MCP.

name: blazium-games-module
description: Blazium engine games call the games module for login, scripted lobbies, and ICE.

name: blazium-games-player
description: Connect an agent to a Blazium Games account as a player through the player MCP server at mcp.blazium.games/player. Checks the account and email, reads the wallet and library, recommends games with cited reasons, searches the catalog, writes reviews and bug reports, shows what friends are playing, explains player scopes and spending limits, and routes to purchases, installs, or launches. Use when the user wants an agent to act for them as a player on Blazium Games, find a game to play, review a game, report a bug, set up the player MCP server, or check what they own or can spend.

name: blazium-games-plugin
description: Godot addon for Blazium Games login, lobby, ICE, bugs, ownership, progress, and item transfer.

name: blazium-games-publish
description: Ships a game page on blazium.games (draft_game_page, bootstrap_game, deploy keys, builds). Use for first-party store publish, page copy, or CI deploy key. Not scene editing, not Steam, and not itch.

name: blazium-games-purchases
description: Buy games and donate on Blazium Games from the account's stored balance. Quotes the price and tax, confirms with the human, buys with an idempotency key, handles per-agent spending limits and emailed approvals, low balance, tops up by card link or x402 USDC, and fetches download links. Use when the user wants to buy, purchase, donate to, or download a game on Blazium Games, check their balance or library, or add balance.

name: blazium-games-store-page
description: Create or update a Blazium Games store page. Drafts the name, tagline, and description from a pitch, creates the page as a draft, updates copy, fills in the taxonomy, images, and similar titles until the listing check passes, sets a price or donations, and changes visibility. Use when the user wants to create a game page, write store copy, rename a game, price a game, accept donations, or publish a page on Blazium Games.

name: blazium-games-unity
description: Unity package com.blazium.games for Blazium Games login, lobby, bugs, progress, and the dedicated server.

name: blazium-games-unreal

name: blazium-genre-tower-defense
description: Composes a path-follow wave tower defense from pinned Blazium 0.8.x skills (navigation, tilemap, resources, UI). Use when the request is TD, waves, creep path, tower placement, or spend-to-build. Not an RTS sandbox and not an idle numbers kit.

name: blazium-genre-visual-novel
description: Composes a visual-novel scene flow from pinned Blazium 0.8.x skills (dialogue, localization, UI, audio, resources). Use when the request is VN, letterbox, CG swap, choice scene, or dialogue-plus-art loop. Not an RPG combat kit and not a talk-graph-only skill.

name: blazium-gif
description: Imports, plays, and records GIFs (GIFTexture, GIFRecorder, ResourceImporterGIF). Use for animated GIF assets or short captures. Not AtlasTexture and not JustAMCP screenshots.

name: blazium-goap
description: Sets up Blazium’s native GOAP planner (BlaziumGoapAgent, goals, actions, world state). Use when an NPC needs planned action sequences. Not a simple FSM and not a behavior-tree rewrite.

name: blazium-httpserver
description: Ships an in-game HTTP REST + SSE server (HTTPServer singleton) and JSON-RPC. Use for custom backends inside the game. Socket.IO client → blazium-socketio. Not editor remote_control or JustAMCP.

name: blazium-hub
description: Operates the Blazium desktop Hub (hub.json, hub-remote ensure, port 39218, blazium://hub). Use when focusing Hub or wiring hub_remote.json. Do not use for blazium-cli install verbs or running-editor HTTP (blazium-cli-remote).

name: blazium-input
description: Configures Blazium 0.8.x InputMap actions, remapping, deadzones, and multi-device bindings on Godot 4.8.x. Use when adding jump/move_* actions, rebinding, gamepad axes, or JustAMCP input_tools (simulate_action, simulate_key, input_record). Not movement math and not Autowork AutoworkInputSender setup.

name: blazium-itch-publish

name: blazium-level-design

description: Implements Blazium matchmaking rooms on 0.8.x / 4.8.x (LobbyClient / ScriptedLobbyClient, reconnect tokens in user://blazium.cfg). Use after a JWT from blazium-services when creating, joining, leaving, or reconnecting. Not raw @rpc, not WebRTCEnetSession, not ENetServer.

name: blazium-localization
description: Sets up Blazium 0.8.x localization with TranslationServer, tr() keys, and CSV/PO translation files on Godot 4.8.x. Use when adding locales, wrapping UI strings, or switching locale in play mode. Large CSV pipelines pair with blazium-csv. Not Theme/layout and not raw table queries.

description: Writes first-class Blazium Luau (.luau): scripts, LSP, JustAMCP register.luau, sandboxed remote eval. Use when editing Luau in a Blazium project. AutoworkTest binds assert_* on newer engines; Hub release CI may still use error()/must().

description: Connects the Blazium editor JustAMCP server (user-blazium-mcp on 127.0.0.1:6506). Discovers toolsets with blazium_list_toolsets / search_tools and reads blazium:// resources. JustAMCP spatial_bake_navigation, navigation_set_layers, navigation_get_info. Not raw physics movement and not GOAP decisions.

description: Bootstraps a version-controlled Blazium project via Hub/CLI (blazium://open) with Autowork, res://mcp, and .gitignore. Use when starting a new Blazium game. Does not implement gameplay. Not project.blazium settings-only and not an editor install via blazium-cli.

name: blazium-nodes-scenes
description: Designs Blazium 0.8.x scene trees (PackedScene instancing, autoloads, composition) on Godot 4.8.x. Use when creating .tscn files, spawning instances, or adding autoloads. Prefer JustAMCP scene_tools and node_tools (create_scene, add_node, instance_scene, save_scene, add_autoload). Not editor MCP connect and not signal wiring.

name: blazium-performance
description: Profiles a Blazium project with JustAMCP monitors (get_performance_monitors, profiling_detect_bottlenecks, profiling_monitor) plus Autowork soak. Use for FPS/memory bottlenecks. Not a generic profiler.

name: blazium-physics

Use when bodies overlap, raycasts miss, monitoring is off, or imported GLB collision is trimesh. Prefer JustAMCP physics_tools (setup_collision, setup_physics_body, validate_physics_setup). Not movement feel and not nav bake.

name: blazium-physics-tuning

name: blazium-project-config
description: Creates or migrates project.blazium / project.godot and safe blazium/* ProjectSettings (JustAMCP, remote_control, Autowork, tags). name: blazium-prototype

name: blazium-rcon

name: blazium-release-checklist

name: blazium-resources
description: Authors Blazium 0.8.x Resource / .tres data (items, stats, configs) on Godot 4.8.x with class_name and @export fields. Use when defining custom Resource types or shared data assets. description: Routes Blazium engine work to the smallest topic skill set. Detects project.blazium (before Godot), classifies the task, and names skills to read. Use at the start of Blazium, JustAMCP, Autowork, Hub/CLI, or project.blazium requests — or when unsure which blazium-* skill applies.

name: blazium-save-systems
description: Persists local game state on Blazium 0.8.x with a versioned schema, user:// slots, ConfigFile or ResourceSaver, and atomic temp-plus-rename writes. Use for save/load, save slots, autosave, or migrating old saves. Not ColdStorage VCS, lobby cloud state, or SQLite tables.

description: Connects the in-engine SocketIOClient singleton (Engine.IO 4, namespaces, poll()). Use for Socket.IO clients inside a Blazium game. Not HTTPServer REST/SSE and not a Socket.IO server.

description: Sketch the shape of an epic before code: modules, data shapes, interfaces and the path between them, for the developer's approval. name: boxbox-discover

name: boxbox-explain

name: boxbox-grill

name: boxbox-inspect

Use after a Boxbox unit is built and verified, when the developer asks for a code review of a branch or diff, when responding to the developer's review or pull request comments, and in page mode after writing a report, context, review or explain page, to fact-check its claims against the repo before the developer sees it.

name: boxbox-lessons
description: Turn the developer's corrections and repeated mistakes into rules and checks so they do not happen again. name: boxbox-plan

It recognises time off and does not flag or count leave. Runs in three scopes - today, week, ahead. This skill only ever looks at the use…

name: breathing-room
description: Quick, lossy compaction of an in-progress work session's accumulated context — long tool outputs, file dumps, exploratory dead ends, superseded reasoning — into a terse working note that preserves only what's needed to keep going, meaning the current goal, decided facts, state of progress, and next step. Use whenever the user asks to compact, trim, or free up context, says things like "give me some breathing room" or "compact this," or when a session has accumulated a lot of large tool outputs and file contents that are no longer being actively referenced. This is deliberately quick and dirty…

name: Breathwork Seminar Marketing Speech Generation
description: Generates persuasive pep talks for specific audiences (such as corporate clients or police departments) to hire the speaker for a breath detox seminar, emphasizing specific benefits and the speaker's credentials.

name: breathwork-practitioner
description: Guide breathwork practices including box breathing, coherent breathing, technique comparisons, safety considerations, and progressive training plans for stress management and performance. Use when the user asks about breathwork practitioner, related techniques, best practices, or needs guidance in this domain. Do NOT use when the request is outside the scope of breathwork practitioner or requires a different specialized skill.

name: breathwork-session
description: Create a breathwork session with structured process, quality checks, and system integration

name: brecahad-mimic-iv-fusion-eval
description: Evaluates a multimodal framework's ability to fuse patch-level histopathology features with structured EHR data for early breast cancer diagnosis, specifically probing performance on class-imbalanced minority classes like mitosis. Use when the user wants to benchmark on BreCaHAD, MIMIC-IV, or asks about evaluating this task. Reports Macro-average AUC.

name: brecha
description: Protocolo de respuesta ante brechas de seguridad de datos personales. Guía el proceso desde la detección hasta la notificación a la AEPD (72 horas, art. 33 RGPD) y la comunicación a los interesados si hay alto riesgo (art. 34 RGPD). Genera checklist de acciones y plantillas de notificación. Usar cuando el usuario dice "brecha de seguridad", "incidente de datos", "notificación AEPD", "nos han hackeado", "fuga de datos", o ante cualquier incidente que afecte a datos personales.

name: brecha
description: Protocolo de respuesta ante brechas de seguridad de datos personales. Guía el proceso desde la detección hasta la notificación conjunta a la ANTAI y a los titulares afectados cuando haya riesgo, en 72 horas, conforme a la Ley 81 de 2019 y el Decreto Ejecutivo 285 de 2021. Genera checklist de acciones y plantillas de notificación. Usar cuando el usuario dice "brecha de seguridad", "incidente de datos", "notificación ANTAI", "nos han hackeado", "fuga de datos", o ante cualquier incidente que afecte a datos personales.

name: brecha-betobetico
description: Protocolo de respuesta ante brechas de seguridad de datos personales. Guía el proceso desde la detección hasta la notificación a la AEPD (72 horas, art. 33 RGPD) y la comunicación a los interesados si hay alto riesgo (art. 34 RGPD). Genera checklist de acciones y plantillas de notificación. Usar cuando el usuario dice "brecha de seguridad", "incidente de datos", "notificación AEPD", "nos han hackeado", "fuga de datos", o ante cualquier incidente que afecte a datos personales.

name: brechas
description: Cruza las dependencias del proyecto (pnpm-lock.yaml o package-lock.json), los servidores MCP y la versión de Claude Code con avisos públicos de seguridad (OSV.dev con GitHub Advisory Database y paquetes maliciosos, CISA KEV, EPSS) y deja un reporte con links en docs/seguridad/. Úsala cuando pidan revisar brechas, CVEs, vulnerabilidades o paquetes maliciosos en las dependencias, y cuando blindar delegue la parte de dependencias.

name: bredvid-andra-sessioner
description: Använd i dealer-repot när arbetet startar i en session eller underagent medan andra sessioner skriver i samma repo - innan en fil ändras, en gren eller ett arbetsträd görs, en ny modul under src/ importeras, ett meddelande skickas till en annan session, eller headless Chrome, grafikkortet eller många testarbetare används. Gäller varje session som inte är huvudagenten, och huvudagenten när den delar ut arbete.

name: bredy-anime-reel
description: 브리디 동물(고양이·강아지·크레·햄스터)이 한국 사람 누구나 아는 애니 명장면을 패러디하는 16~25초 릴스·쇼츠를 만든다. 기획 관문(아는 장면·원작 OST·웃음 대비 한 줄) → 비트 단위 콘티 → Veo 클립 생성 → 자막·리듬 편집 → 사용자 미리보기 확인 → 게시까지. 사용자가 '애니 패러디 릴스', '애니 명장면 숏폼', '명장면 동물 버전', '애니 밈 영상 만들어' 등을 요청할 때 쓴다. 매일 유행 밈 영상은 bredy-meme-reel, 매물 홍보 카드는 bredy-sns-promo.

name: bredy-app-deploy
description: 브리디 앱(bredy_app, Expo)을 운영에 내보낸다. JS 만 바뀌었으면 코드푸시(EAS Update)로 바로 내고, 네이티브가 바뀌었으면 Android·iOS 스토어 빌드(EAS 클라우드, Android 한도 소진 시 로컬 빌드)를 만들어 Play 프로덕션·App Store 심사까지 제출한다. 사전 검사, 웹 선배포 확인, 버전·출시 노트, 런타임 기록, 태그까지 한다. 사용자가 '앱 배포해줘', '브리디 앱 배포', '다음 버전 빌드해서 업데이트', '스토어 올려줘', '플레이스토어 올려줘', '앱스토어 제출', 'iOS 배포', '코드푸시', 'OTA 업데이트', '앱 수정 바로 반영' 등을 요청할 때 사용한다. 웹(breeder_web) 배포는 breeder-web-deploy 스킬, 스토어 스크린샷 디자인은 bredy_app docs/store-screenshots.md 를 따른다.

name: bredy-cafe-activity
description: 브리디 운영자 네이버 계정으로 생물 카페(물생활 홈다리·파충류 파사모·곤충 개미마을)의 최근 질문글에 정보성 답 댓글을 달고, 같은 주제로 네이버 블로그(bredy_team) 정보글을 써서 댓글 끝에 그 블로그 링크를 남긴다(블로그 글 끝에서 브리디로 연결). 질문 고르기 → 본문·댓글 읽기 → 블로그 글 발행 → 카페 댓글 → 기록·보고까지 한다. 사용자가 '카페 활동해줘', '카페 활동', '카페 질문에 답 달아줘', '홈다리 댓글', '파사모 댓글', '카페에 정보 댓글', '카페 영업' 등을 요청할 때 사용한다. 브리디 앱 안 커뮤니티에 크루 계정으로 글을 쓰는 일은 bredy-crew-activity 스킬, 인스타 DM 영업은 bredy-instagram-outreach 스킬 담당.

name: bredy-cafe-research
description: 브리디 시장조사용으로 네이버 카페(식물·강아지·고양이·물고기·거북이·소동물 등) 최근 글의 제목·본문·사진을 브리디 자동화 크롬(9222) 네이버 로그인으로 수집하고, 카페별 글 수·반응·게시판·많이 나온 말·분양 비중·가격을 집계한다. 종별 대표 카페 찾기 → 활동량 확인 → 수집(글 사이 3~5초, 이어받기) → 잠긴 글 점검 → 집계 보고(report.md)까지 한다. 사용자가 '카페 크롤링', '카페 글 수집', '○○ 카페 30개 긁어줘', '네이버 카페 시장조사', '카페 사진이랑 글 받아줘', '카페 집계' 등을 요청할 때 사용한다. 카페에 댓글·글을 다는 일은 bredy-cafe-activity, 로봇천국 카페 운영은 robot-cafe-content 담당.

name: bredy-content
description: 브리디(bredy.app) 인스타그램·쓰레드용 마케팅 콘텐츠(카드뉴스 이미지 4:5, 15초 릴스 영상 9:16)를 브랜드 템플릿으로 만들고, 영업 멘트·콘텐츠 캘린더·자동 게시 설계를 다룬다. 사용자가 '브리디 카드뉴스', '브리디 릴스', '인스타 콘텐츠 만들어줘', '오늘 콘텐츠', '쓰레드 게시물', '분양/경매/동네 브리더/혈통 홍보', '마케팅 자동화', '영업 멘트' 등을 요청할 때 사용한다.

name: bredy-crew-activity
description: 브레디 크루(운영 계정)로 반려생활 커뮤니티에 활동한다. 생물 분류마다 정보·댓글·토론·질문 역할을 맡은 크루가 있다. 실행할 때마다 최근 글을 읽고, 역할에 맞는 새 글·찬반 토론과 글 내용에 맞는 댓글·좋아요·팔로우(필요하면 혈통) 계획을 짜서, AI 냄새 검사(lint)와 사람 말투 다듬기를 거쳐 사용자 확인 뒤 API 로 실행한다. "크루 활동", "운영 계정 활동", "커뮤니티 채우기", "크루 글 AI 냄새", "크루 프로필 바꿔"를 요청할 때 쓴다.

name: bredy-feature-flow
description: 브리디(bredy_app 앱 + breeder_web 웹·서버)에 새 기능을 기획부터 출시 직전까지 한 번에 만든다. PRD(docs/prd) → 당근 톤 시안 HTML·PNG(design/mockups) → 지정한 사용자군 페르소나 피드백(서브에이전트) → PRD v2 → 서버·웹·앱 동시 구현(마이그레이션은 migrate deploy 만) → 테스트·웹 E2E·에뮬레이터 캡처 → pr-assets 업로드 → 웹 dev PR + 앱 master 푸시(Parity 트레일러) → 문서·메모리 기록까지 한다. 사용자가 '브리디에 ○○ 기능 추가해줘', 'PRD부터 써주고 기획 디자인하고 만들어줘', '20대 여자(○○ 사용자) 피드백 받아서 만들어', '기획→디자인→구현 다 해줘' 등을 요청할 때 사용한다. 작은 버그 수정·문구 변경, 배포만(bredy-app-deploy·breeder-web-deploy), PRD 문서만(hjjm-prd)에는 쓰지 않는다.

name: bredy-instagram-outreach
description: 브리디 공식 인스타 계정(bredy_breeder)으로 크레·파충류 브리더·샵·키우는 사람에게만 영업 DM 을 보내고 답장을 처리한다. 브리디 자동화 크롬(scripts/ig.mjs)으로 DM함 답장 정리 → 남은 창립 브리더 자리 확인 → 유형별 공통 문구에 닉네임만 넣어 하루 20명까지 발송 → targets.csv 기록 → 보고까지 한다. "인스타 DM 영업", "인스타 영업 돌려", "DM 보내줘", "인스타 답장 확인", "영업 메시지 보내", "브리더 DM", 아침·점심·저녁 자동 영업 일정 실행 때 쓴다.

name: bredy-kakao-openchat-room
description: 브리디 카카오톡 오픈채팅방(종별 홍보방)을 하나 더 연다. breeder_web 의 종별 소식 문구 기능(`/admin/kakao-digest`, 매일 08시 운영자 푸시)에 방을 추가하고(KAKAO_DIGEST_ROOMS 한 줄), dev DB 읽기 전용 조회로 종 필터를 확인하고, 관리자 화면 캡처와 dev PR 을 만든 뒤, 카톡에서 방을 만들 때 쓸 방 이름·해시태그·공지·방장봇 문구까지 써 준다. 사용자가 '오픈채팅방 추가', '곤충방도 만들어', '물고기 톡방 열자', '카톡방 소식 문구에 ○○ 추가', '오픈채팅 소식 종 늘려', '톡방 공지 써줘' 등을 요청할 때 사용한다. 소식 기능 자체(문구 형식·조회 기준·크론)를 바꾸거나 카톡 자동 발송 봇을 만들 때는 쓰지 않는다.

name: bredy-overseas-research
description: 브리디 시장조사용으로 해외 반려생활 커뮤니티(미국·영어권 Reddit, 대만 PTT, 미국 XenForo 포럼 TheCatSite·dogforum 등)에서 강아지·고양이·파충류·식물·거북이·물고기·햄스터 글의 제목·본문·사진을 수집하고 사이트별로 집계한다. 종별 사이트 고르기 → 접속 확인 → 사이트 형태별 수집기 실행(이어받기) → 집계 보고까지 한다. 사용자가 '해외 크롤링', '해외 사이트 수집', '레딧 수집', 'PTT 수집', '해외 커뮤니티 시장조사', '외국 반려동물 글 모아줘', '해외에서 ○○ 200개씩' 등을 요청할 때 사용한다. 네이버 카페 수집은 bredy-cafe-research 담당.

name: bredy-posthog-event
description: 브리디 앱(bredy_app)·웹(breeder_web)에 PostHog 이벤트를 추가·수정한다. 서버 이벤트(captureServerEvent + platform), 웹 클라이언트 이벤트(trackEvent·ANALYTICS_EVENTS), 앱 이벤트(captureAppEvent)를 고르고, 이벤트 이름 등록 → 호출 → jest 목 정리 → 기준표 docs/current/posthog-events.md 갱신 → 웹 PR·앱 master 커밋(Parity 트레일러) → 배포 뒤 PostHog MCP 로 수신 확인·인사이트까지 한다. 사용자가 '포스트호그 이벤트 추가', '이벤트 심어줘', 'PostHog 트래킹', '사용률 보게 해줘', '가입률·전환율·이탈률 측정', '이 기능 몇 명 쓰는지 보고 싶어', '분석 이벤트 넣어줘' 등을 요청하거나 새 기능에 계측을 붙일 때 사용한다. 이미 쌓인 데이터를 분석만 할 때는 PostHog MCP 를 바로 쓰고 이 스킬은 쓰지 않는다.

name: bredy-prod-db-write
description: 브리디 운영 DB(Supabase 'bredy')의 데이터를 몇 행 고친다 — 혜택·뱃지 재부여(창립 브리더 등), 잘못 들어간 값 수정, 특정 행 상태 되돌리기처럼 관리자 화면에 기능이 없는 일. 읽기 전용 계정으로 대상 행을 찾아 보여 주고, 쓰기 계정으로 트랜잭션 미리보기(ROLLBACK)를 한 뒤, 바뀔 행 수가 예상과 같을 때만 COMMIT 하고 다시 조회해 확인한다. 사용자가 '운영 DB 고쳐', '운영 데이터 수정', '○○님 혜택 다시 줘', '창립 브리더 다시 부여', '뱃지 되돌려', '운영에서 이 값 바꿔줘' 등을 요청할 때 사용한다. 스키마 변경(마이그레이션)·dev DB·대량 정리·백업 복원에는 쓰지 않는다.

name: bredy-region-check

Couvre idée ou intuition, problème métier, besoin d'un client, projet informatique ou ERP, transformation, cahier des charges, appel d'offres, projet déjà engagé, solution à auditer. Distingue vérifié, déclaré et supposé, contredit quand c'est justifié, fait valider les décisions par l'utilisateur et tient un référentiel du projet. À utiliser quand l'utilisateur veut lancer, clarifier, cadrer, structurer, reprendre ou réorienter un projet, demande par où commencer…

name: cadrage-solutions
description: Explore et compare des options de solution pour un projet sur des critères issus des objectifs et contraintes, y compris conserver l'existant, simplifier, expérimenter ou ne pas poursuivre, puis formule une recommandation justifiée sans favoriser la première idée. À utiliser quand l'utilisateur hésite entre plusieurs solutions, outils, prestataires ou approches, demande laquelle choisir, arrive avec une solution déjà retenue à éprouver, ou demande de vérifier le raisonnement derrière un choix avant de le présenter (solution comparison, options analysis, make or buy). Fait partie de la famille…

name: cadre
description: Cadrer un projet par questionnement structuré et produire ou étendre `docs/PRD.md` selon un template fixe en 8 sections (Problème, Solution, Utilisateur cible, User Stories, Critères de succès, Hors périmètre, Décisions d'implémentation, Notes complémentaires). Utilise sur /cadre, "cadre ce projet", "écris le PRD", "fais-moi un PRD", "crée le PRD", "produis le PRD", "étends le PRD", ou dès qu'il faut formaliser le cadrage d'un projet dans un document versionné. Pair naturel de /interroge (amont) et /planifie (aval).

name: cadre-editor
description: Record and edit screen recordings in the Cadre app via its Agent API (MCP). Use whenever the user wants to capture a demo, or to tighten, zoom, cut, caption, restyle, or export a Cadre recording — e.g. "record a 30-second demo of this and cut it", "tighten this demo", "zoom on the part where I click deploy", "caption it and export", "cut the dead air". Covers recording control, the inspect-first workflow, concrete tool recipes, and the guardrails that keep agent edits from fighting the user's manual work.

name: cadre-motion-graphics
description: Design and place motion graphics — native templates, animated SVG cards, callouts, lower thirds, arrows, title text, and externally rendered animation clips — on a Cadre recording through its Agent API (MCP). Use whenever the user wants graphics on a talking-head or camera-only take ("put animations next to me while I talk", "add a lower third", "make a title card", "annotate this with arrows and labels", "turn my update into something that looks produced"), or callouts on a screen recording. name: cadre-orchestrator
description: Select, dispatch, and gate cadre roles in Hermes.

name: cadre-reponse
description: Répondre dans le cadre de réponse technique (CRT) imposé par l'acheteur d'un marché public : reprendre sa structure à l'identique, traiter chaque exigence numérotée, vérifier la couverture et reporter la réponse dans son fichier Word.

name: cadrer-et-planifier
description: Transforme une demande en conception approuvee puis en plan d'implementation, avant de toucher au code. Couvre l'exploration du contexte, la verification du perimetre (decomposer avant d'affiner), les questions posees UNE A LA FOIS, deux ou trois approches avec recommandation, la conception presentee section par section avec accord a chaque section, les criteres d'acceptation falsifiables, puis le plan : carte des fichiers avant les taches, decoupage par responsabilite, calibrage d'une tache, contraintes globales recopiees verbatim. A utiliser des qu'un travail depasse quelques heures, qu'on…

name: cadrer-story
description: Transforme un requis brut — une phrase, une décision consignée, un finding d'audit, une contrainte reçue d'un tiers — en stories `à faire` prêtes pour /deliver-story : critères en Étant donné/Quand/Alors, décisions consignées, priorité et dépendances posées. Écrit dans un fichier d'epic, ne code jamais.

name: cadrer-un-projet
description: Use when the user describes something to build that has no ticket and no code yet — a new project, or a feature they state before it exists. Runs three framing stages in conversation and lands the answers in the project sheet, never in a standalone document. Do not use for a question about existing code, for a ticket that already exists, or for a "what if we…" that is not going to be built.

name: cadrer-un-visuel
description: Use when a screen or interface is about to be built and no mockup is referenced — in the ticket or in the project sheet — or when the user asks to mock up, sketch or think through the design of such a screen. name: cady
description: Reads the company's context in Cady, then loads the matching skill. name: cady-accounting-method
description: Accounting role card: what this function owns and decides. Load when acting as the Accounting agent or choosing among its skills. Not for doing a task: load the task skill.

name: cady-accounting-period-close
description: Month-end and period close. Use when: Close the books for a month, quarter or year: reconcile bank, payouts and revenue, clear Suspense and lock. Not for: Preparing a tax return (use `cady-finance-tax-cycle`), budgets or runway, or audit sign-off.

name: cady-company-change-agent-behaviour
description: Change agent behaviour. Use when: Change what agents do: edit a skill, role card, run sequence, tool text or an agent's goal. Not for: Making, scheduling or retiring an agent (`cady-company-manage-agents`), or writing or judging a post or design.

name: cady-company-decision
description: Who decides, and how to record it. Use when: Before a choice or an effect: whether it is decided, who decides, how to test a big call and how to record it. Not for: Gathering the evidence a call needs (`cady-company-evidence`), the weekly goal calls (`cady-company-weekly-review`), or doing the task itself.

name: cady-company-evidence
description: Key questions and behaviour tests. Use when: A decision you own needs evidence: frame its questions, take the cheapest route, pre-register any test of behaviour. Not for: Dashboards, reports or data no decision needs; company goals and strategy (`cady-company-weekly-review`); deciding the answer for another owner; routine delivery whose desired behaviour is clear (`cady-engineering-method`).

name: cady-company-manage-agents
description: Manage company agents. Use when: Create and bind, schedule, review or retire a company agent: whether one is warranted, its design and first task. Not for: Native helpers, subagents, one-off work items and agents on a host that is in contact.

name: cady-company-method
description: Executive role card: its point and key bets. Load when acting as the Executive agent (the outer loop). Not for doing a task: load the task skill.

name: cady-company-onboarding
description: Set up a company and hand over to its Executive. Use when: A new company has no Cady setup yet: record it from what the owner says and set up its Executive agent. Not for: Designing or taking an agent live (`cady-company-manage-agents`), or building a first offering (`cady-gtm-launch`).

name: cady-company-operations-compliance-register
description: Compliance register and monthly filing review. Use when: What statutory and registry filings the company owes and when (annual returns, confirmation statements, state reports). Not for: Preparing one tax return (`cady-finance-tax-cycle`), submitting any filing or payment, or legal advice.

name: cady-company-operations-contract-checks
description: Contract checks: before signing, after completion. Use when: A contract that commits the company is about to be signed or was just signed: what to settle first and what it starts. Not for: Posts or updates about it, the yearly filing calendar (`cady-company-operations-compliance-register`), general legal questions, or a contract not yet in view.

name: cady-company-operations-inbox-follow-through
description: Inbox follow-through: group, triage, track commitments. Use when: Bounded inbox maintenance or thread triage for follow-through, marketing handling or commitments needing tracking. Not for: Executing a prospect reply (`cady-gtm-reply`), sending or drafting outreach, or reading mail Cady is not given: only the host's connector reads mail. Thread triage remains in scope.

name: cady-company-operations-method
description: Company Operations role card: what this function owns and decides. Load when acting as the Company Operations agent or choosing among its skills. Not for doing a task: load the task skill.

name: cady-company-operations-people-lifecycle

name: cady-company-operations-requirement-register

name: cady-company-taste-review
description: Writing craft and taste decisions. Use when: Write or edit a post, article, web copy or other public text, or review a design (judge with the taste check). Not for: Pass/fail checks a script or test can decide (run those first), a direct message to one person, or writing a prompt or skill and changing how agents behave (`cady-company-change-agent-behaviour`).

name: cady-company-weekly-review

name: cady-customer-success-lifecycle
description: Customer lifecycle: first value to renewal. Use when: Run one customer account after the sale: onboarding to first value, health, risk, renewal, expansion or cancellation. Not for: Open deals before signature (`cady-sales-deal-motion`), the company's own vendor renewals (`cady-finance-vendor-spend-review`), or message copy alone (`cady-gtm-reply` or `cady-gtm-warm-email`).

name: cady-customer-success-method

name: cady-engineering-debugging
description: Debugging and incident response. Use when: Find and fix the root cause of a bug, failing check or production incident, then the regression test and postmortem. Not for: Rating a bug's severity or triaging a flaky test, reviewing someone's diff (use `cady-engineering-independent-review`) or recurring backlog review (use `cady-engineering-system-cycle`).

name: cady-engineering-independent-review

Use when: a change needs review, before merge or in a later batch, or a decision others will build on before it is acted on. Not for: root-causing a bug, triaging a bug report or running helpers (`cady-orchestrator-goal-pass`).

name: cady-engineering-integrations
description: Integrations. Choose, operate or build a company integration: compare and pick a tool or vendor to connect (the vendor reference), operate a chosen connector (the connector reference) or build one (the build reference). Use when: comparing, choosing or connecting a tool, data source or account. Not for: a purchase or renewal decision on cost (use `cady-finance-vendor-spend-review`).

name: cady-engineering-method
description: Engineering role card: what this function owns and decides. Load when acting as the Engineering agent or choosing among its skills. Not for doing a task: load the task skill.

name: cady-engineering-system-cycle

Not for: One bounded change with clear acceptance (use `cady-engineering-method`) or deciding what to build and for whom (use `cady-product-manage`).

name: cady-finance-budget-review

name: cady-finance-tax-cycle

name: cady-finance-vendor-spend-review

name: cady-fundraise-investor-list

name: cady-gtm-calls

name: cady-gtm-channel-plan

name: cady-gtm-events
description: Events: attend or host. Use when: Prepare for or host the event named in the brief to advance the company through real conversations. Not for: Choosing an event or treating an attendee directory as intent.

name: cady-gtm-launch

name: cady-gtm-reply

name: cancer-buddy-education
description: 生成来源可追溯的肿瘤患者教育材料，解释稳定概念并把个体问题整理给主诊团队。可在实时核验现行一手来源后转述指南对“这类情况”的一般推荐（含具体方案/线次名称，带来源），但不替患者选定方案。指南、药品标签、获批状态、预后数字、随访和急诊阈值必须在回答时从版本可核验的一手来源读取：可用用户合法持有的现行指南并标版本/页码，否则实时查官方来源；不可用时失败关闭，不以模型记忆兜底。Triggers on 患者教育, 宣教手册, 看懂癌症, 看懂治疗, NCCN, CSCO, 指南建议, 严不严重, 能治好吗.

name: cancer-buddy-find-care

name: cancer-buddy-visit-prep

name: cancer-cell-of-origin-annotation

name: cancer-cohort-expression-profiling

name: cancer-driver-candidate-comparison-against-reference-catalogs

name: cancer-driver-gene-benchmark-scoring

name: cancer-driver-gene-classification

name: cancer-driver-gene-classification

name: cancer-driver-network-inference
description: Use when the goal is to infer a context-specific cancer network from mutated seed genes and quantitatively compare driver-gene recovery (precision/recall vs IntOGen) across network inference methods under cross-validation.

name: cancer-functional-genomics

name: cancer-gene-census-reference-list-validation

name: candle-trade

Builds on candor-core.
